card.name: Partway through split-up words
card.fires_on: Short word pieces in the middle or at the end of a longer word that is broken into parts, such as drug names, medical terms and names. Often the next piece finishes the word.

modes.label: Split drug names
modes.description: Inside brand or generic drug names broken into pieces.

modes.label: Split medical terms
modes.description: Inside ordinary medical words or headings cut into pieces, including spaced-out capitals.

modes.label: Split names and plain words
modes.description: Inside a person's name or an ordinary word in general web text.

card.plain: It fires when a long word, often a drug name, is cut into pieces and the model is in the middle of it.
